title: Kaise ho musalman
body:
kaise ho musalman charaghon ko bujhado
shehzadi e kaunain khule sar hai rida do
<<DIVIDER>>
uth'ta hua qaimon se dhuan dekhne walon
islam ke ghar may hai lagi aag bujhado
kaise ho musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
is din ke liye paala tha kya binte nabi ne
shabbir ka sar kaat ke naize pe chadado
kaise ho musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghodon se tan e sibte nabi raundh rahe ho
dar par hai behan ran ki zara khaak uda do
kaise ho musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye shaam ka bazaar mohamed ki nawasi
uryan sar e islam hai chadar to udha do
kaise ho musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa dekh na le sar ko kahin bar sare naiza
jis par sar e asghar hai zara door hata do
kaise ho musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghabrake tamachon se ye kehti thi sakina
achi phupi amma mere ammu ko bula do
kaise ho musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ke matam ki sada goonj rahi hai
utho meri awaaz se awaaz mila do
kaise ho musalman...
